name: Kraul
description: A Golgari people who allied with Vraska.

description_citations.text: "Vraska". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sobeslav and his guards squeeze through a crevice into a cavern with a carved slab and discover hundreds of kraul clinging to the ceiling.
timeline.quote: There, clinging to the ceiling, waiting for their arrival, were the kraul.

citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Mazirek drops from the ceiling and mocks Sobeslav as Jarad's lapdog; the kraul laugh and begin killing the Golgari by mind-attack.
timeline.quote: I invited Jarad vod Savo, and I received his lapdog instead.

citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Guards collapse one by one as Mazirek kills them with the kraul's laughter, one piece of brain at a time, saving Sobeslav for last.
timeline.quote: I've been killing you and your guards for the last three minutes, one piece of your brain at a time.

citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The kraul chant as Mazirek harvests the souls of the dying guards and channels their power into his staff.
timeline.quote: Mazirek reached out and caught the power that resonated with each deceased soul

citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: With the power of sixteen souls, Mazirek shoves aside the stone slab and opens a mausoleum full of hundreds of stone coffins.
timeline.quote: He gripped either side of the stone slab and shoved it to the side.

citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Mazirek names the mausoleum Umerilek, the salvation of the kraul and key to a Golgari empire.
timeline.quote: Umerilek, Mausoleum of the Erstwhile, the salvation of the kraul and the key to the creation of the Golgari empire.

citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Castan destroys three Kraul warriors with a lightning spell as more attack.
timeline.quote: Castan sent an arcing lighting spell into them

citation.text: "Castan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Madarrak flees and Castan is left alone surrounded by Kraul; her fate is unknown.
timeline.quote: Castan was left alone in the Undercity, surrounded by hordes of Kraul

citation.text: "Castan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Vraska becomes Golgari guildmaster, the Kraul gain a more important role and become loyal to her personally rather than to the Swarm.
timeline.quote: After Vraska became guildmaster , the Kraul gained a more important role and became loyal to her personally instead of to the Swarm.

citation.text: "Insect", section "Kraul". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kraul attack and a deformed mutant pins Madarrak.
timeline.quote: a monstrously deformed human who launched itself at Madarrak

citation.text: "Madarrak", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska kills Jarad and establishes herself as Golgari guildmaster.
timeline.quote: Vraska killed Jarad and established herself as guildmaster

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Guildmaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: death priest and leader of the kraul
relations.quote: I was born into my duty.

citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

pages_say.description: An insectoid race that recently pledged allegiance to the Golgari after centuries unguilded and who serve as laborers.

citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

pages_say.description: Insectoid hordes that attacked in the Undercity.

citation.text: "Castan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Six-legged insectile beings on the Swarm's periphery who, under Mazirek, are loyal to Vraska.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Sapient six-legged insectile beings of Ravnica's Undercity, loyal to Vraska personally after she became Golgari guildmaster.
